In 2022 in China, PV rolled glass production was growing explosively, reaching a capacity of 84 kt/day across 442 production lines (Shanghai Non ferrous Metals 2023). The average price of PV glass from China in 2022 was $2.90/m2 and $3.75/m2 for 2 mm and 3.2 mm, respectively (Shanghai Non ferrous Metals 2023). In early 2024, Infolink reported Chinese spot prices of $2.36/m2 and $3.62/m2 for 2 mm and 3.2 mm solar glass, respectively (InfoLink Consulting Co. 2025). Table 6. Many upstream inputs are not discussed owing to limited supply chain information or relatively low importance (e.g., for inputs such as dolomite, alumina, and material needed for antireflective coatings). • Cullet: Cullet is clean, crushed glass fed back into glass manufacturing, offsetting virgin materials. Up to 30% cullet can easily be used in standard glass manufacturing, yielding 49 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications. energy savings and reduced gaseous reaction products (Hubert 2015). Some manufacturers target 50% cullet (Devlin 2025). This cullet is primarily pre-consumer to reduce contamination risks. Post-consumer cullet is not yet used in PV glass, but SolarCycle is establishing PV recycling in conjunction with a new rolled glass manufacturing line, which would bring post-consumer cullet into the supply chain (Pickerel 2024e). Also see Section 7.1. • Low-iron silica sand: The United States is a leading global silica sand (95% purity) producer, producing 130 million t of sand and gravel in 2024, 7% of which went to glass making (U.S. Geological Survey 2025j). Not all this material is suitable for PV glass, because less than 0.1% iron oxide content is required, either from naturally low impurities or use of cleaning processes (Thomsen et al. 2009; Heidari and Anctil 2022).
